report_identity.report_title: Luks Group (Vietnam Holdings) Company Limited Annual Report 2025

business_overview.one_sentence: The group manufactures and sells cement in Vietnam, holds rental properties in Vietnam, Hong Kong and Mainland China, operates hotels, and has small property development and electronic products activities.
business_overview.revenue_model: Cement and electronic product sales are recognized on delivery; property management and hotel services are recognized over time or as services are rendered; investment properties generate rental income.
business_notes: Two cement customers each contributed more than 10% of group revenue in 2025.
Vietnam accounted for HK$243.358 million of external revenue and HK$1.011 billion of non-current assets in 2025.
The group disclosed no bank or other borrowings at 31 December 2025.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Reported profits are distorted by property fair value movements and impairments; operating cash flow remained positive for 2023-2025. Interest income is excluded from owner-earnback profit when cash/deposit principal is deducted as detachable funds.

gaps: Annual report discloses RMB and VND cash amounts but does not split cash by parent company, subsidiary, bank account, deposit tenor within 3-12 months versus under 3 months, or jurisdiction for the remaining cash.
No explicit restricted cash balance was found; analysis treats disclosed non-pledged deposits as unrestricted but applies jurisdiction/currency haircuts.
Maintenance versus growth capital expenditure is not separately disclosed; owner-earnback uses recent reported capital expenditure and a conservative profit haircut.
